# rsxr

R bindings for [rsx](https://github.com/HaoZeke/rsx-rs), a
high-performance streaming toolkit for RAD-seq sex determination.

## Statement of need

Sex-determination studies from RAD-seq data need marker depth tables,
group contrasts, and frequentist or Bayesian triage. The **rsx** engine
implements those steps with bounded-memory streaming and a C API.
**rsxr** exposes that API in-process from R (no subprocess), so analysts
can run `process`, `freq`, `distrib`, `signif`, `triage`, `depth`,
`merge`, and `pca` and consume results as tibbles without leaving R. It
targets R-first workflows that already use popmaps and RADSex-compatible
marker TSVs.

rsxr talks to rsx through R’s native C interface: the package’s C glue
calls the rsx C API directly and links against the rsxcore static
library. There is no intermediate serialization beyond the marker TSVs
the commands already stream.

## Requirements

- A Rust toolchain (`cargo`, `rustc`); see <https://rustup.rs>. Minimum
  supported Rust version is recorded in `DESCRIPTION` as
  `Config/rsxr/MSRV`.
- The **rsxcore** sources as a sibling of this package (`../rsxcore`
  inside the rsx-rs monorepo). Otherwise set `RSX_CORE_DIR` before
  installing.
- On Linux, development headers for zlib, bzip2, and xz if the linker
  cannot find them.

## Install

From GitHub (package lives in the `rsx-r` subdirectory):

``` r

# pak
pak::pak("HaoZeke/rsx-rs/rsx-r")

# remotes
remotes::install_github("HaoZeke/rsx-rs", subdir = "rsx-r")
```

From a local clone of [rsx-rs](https://github.com/HaoZeke/rsx-rs):

``` bash
cd rsx-r
R CMD INSTALL .
# or with the package pixi environment (R + cargo pinned):
pixi run install
```

## Usage

### Low-level (mirrors the CLI)

``` r

library(rsxr)

rsx_version()

rsx_process("reads/", "markers.tsv", threads = 8L, min_depth = 5L)
rsx_signif("markers.tsv", "popmap.tsv", "signif.tsv",
           test = "fisher", correction = "fdr", bayes = TRUE)
rsx_triage("markers.tsv", "popmap.tsv", "triage.tsv", min_depth = 10L)
```

### High-level (tibbles)

``` r

mt <- marker_table("markers.tsv")

triaged <- triage(mt, popmap = "popmap.tsv", min_depth = 10L)
sig     <- signif_markers(mt, popmap = "popmap.tsv", test = "fisher")
dist    <- distrib(mt, popmap = "popmap.tsv", group1 = "M", group2 = "F")
freqs   <- frequencies(mt, min_depth = 5L)
```

See
[`vignette("rsxr", package = "rsxr")`](https://haozeke.github.io/rsx-rs/rsxr/articles/rsxr.md)
after install.

## Ecosystem

rsxr is the R entry point to the rsx engine. Companion R packages for
sex-balanced FST / heterozygosity (ChromSex) and sdY PCR assay audit
(SexPCR) consume the same marker outputs; those repositories are not yet
public.

## Contributing and community guidelines

Contributions are welcome. Please open issues and pull requests on the
[rsx-rs repository](https://github.com/HaoZeke/rsx-rs).

- Contribution guidelines: repository root
  [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://github.com/HaoZeke/rsx-rs/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- Code of conduct: repository root
  [`CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`](https://github.com/HaoZeke/rsx-rs/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
  (if present) or the GitHub Community Guidelines

For the R package specifically:

``` bash
cd rsx-r
pixi install
pixi run document   # roxygen2
pixi run test
pixi run check      # rcmdcheck --no-manual
```

# Package index

## High-level workflow

- [`marker_table()`](https://haozeke.github.io/rsx-rs/rsxr/reference/marker_table.md)
  : Create a marker table handle
- [`triage()`](https://haozeke.github.io/rsx-rs/rsxr/reference/triage.md)
  : Bayesian sex-linkage triage
- [`signif_markers()`](https://haozeke.github.io/rsx-rs/rsxr/reference/signif_markers.md)
  : Significant sex-linked markers
- [`distrib()`](https://haozeke.github.io/rsx-rs/rsxr/reference/distrib.md)
  : Marker distribution across groups
- [`depth()`](https://haozeke.github.io/rsx-rs/rsxr/reference/depth.md)
  : Per-individual marker depth
- [`frequencies()`](https://haozeke.github.io/rsx-rs/rsxr/reference/frequencies.md)
  : Per-marker allele frequencies

## Low-level commands

- [`rsx_process()`](https://haozeke.github.io/rsx-rs/rsxr/reference/rsx_process.md)
  : Process demultiplexed reads into a marker depth table
- [`rsx_freq()`](https://haozeke.github.io/rsx-rs/rsxr/reference/rsx_freq.md)
  : Compute per-marker allele frequencies
- [`rsx_distrib()`](https://haozeke.github.io/rsx-rs/rsxr/reference/rsx_distrib.md)
  : Marker distribution across groups
- [`rsx_signif()`](https://haozeke.github.io/rsx-rs/rsxr/reference/rsx_signif.md)
  : Extract significant sex-linked markers
- [`rsx_triage()`](https://haozeke.github.io/rsx-rs/rsxr/reference/rsx_triage.md)
  : Bayesian sex-linkage triage of markers
- [`rsx_depth()`](https://haozeke.github.io/rsx-rs/rsxr/reference/rsx_depth.md)
  : Marker depth per individual
- [`rsx_merge()`](https://haozeke.github.io/rsx-rs/rsxr/reference/rsx_merge.md)
  : Merge marker depth tables (bounded memory)
- [`rsx_pca()`](https://haozeke.github.io/rsx-rs/rsxr/reference/rsx_pca.md)
  : Streaming PCA of the marker matrix
- [`rsx_version()`](https://haozeke.github.io/rsx-rs/rsxr/reference/rsx_version.md)
  : rsx C library version
